title: Modern Kitchen Overhaul
description: A complete kitchen renovation featuring custom white oak cabinetry, quartz countertops, and a herringbone tile backsplash. Opened up the floor plan for a spacious, light-filled cooking space.

title: Craftsman Bathroom Suite
description: Transformed a dated bathroom into a spa-like retreat with floor-to-ceiling tile, a freestanding tub, frameless glass shower, and custom vanity with vessel sink.

title: Backyard Deck & Pergola
description: Designed and built a multi-level composite deck with integrated lighting, a cedar pergola, and built-in bench seating for the ultimate outdoor entertaining space.

title: Open-Concept Living Room
description: Removed load-bearing walls and installed steel beams to create a stunning open-concept living area with hardwood floors, a custom fireplace mantel, and recessed lighting.

title: Second Story Addition
description: Added a full second story with two bedrooms, a bath, and a home office. Seamlessly matched the existing architectural style with new siding, roofing, and trim.

title: Custom Built-In Library
description: Floor-to-ceiling built-in bookshelves with integrated ladder rail, LED cabinet lighting, and a reading nook — a true showcase of fine finish carpentry.
